verdict.rationale: v0 docs show clear support for connecting projects to backend services and third-party integrations (Supabase, Upstash Redis, Neon Postgres, AI providers) and securely storing API keys/credentials, plus a general 'third-party services for external data and functionality' hook, which covers server-side function-like backend connections. However, no evidence specifically confirms out-of-the-box payments (e.g., Stripe) or email (e.g., Resend/SendGrid) integrations, nor detailed docs on writing custom server-side functions beyond generic 'connect to backend' language. Missing for 10: explicit payment-provider integration examples, explicit email-service integration examples, and documentation of custom server-side function authoring within the builder.
